name: Whiskers
description: Governed infrastructure operations for AI agents: Docker hosts, Kubernetes workloads, logs, CVEs and cloud servers through scoped tools (Read/Write/Admin), code-enforced guardrails and human approvals. Self-hosted, SSH-key-free (mesh + mTLS).
author: LupusMalusDeviant

tools.name: hetzner_change_server_type
tools.description: Change (resize) a Hetzner server's type, e.g. 'cx32' (by Whiskers name or id). The server must be powered off first. upgradeDisk=true also grows the disk (then a downgrade is no longer possible).

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

serverType.description: Target server type name, e.g. cx32

upgradeDisk.description: Also upgrade the disk (irreversible). Default false.

tools.name: get_host_load
tools.description: Report each server's current host load and how much of it the containers actually account for. Use this when a host looks busy but no container explains it — that gap means a process outside the containers (dockerd, a backup job, a runaway service) is the likely cause, which per-container stats can never show. The two CPU figures use different conventions and are reconciled here. Read-only.

tools.name: detect_database
tools.description: Detect the database type of a container. Returns the database engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j) or 'None'.

tools.name: list_git_deploy_apps
tools.description: List the applications Whiskers deploys from Git: repository, branch, compose path, target server, and the outcome, time and commit of the last deploy. Read-only — this cannot start a deploy.

tools.name: update_container
tools.description: Pull latest image and recreate a Docker container (update).

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: List the DNS records of a zone (e.g. 'lupusmalus.dev') at the configured DNS provider. Names are relative to the zone ('@' = the zone itself). Optionally filter by name and/or type. Read-only.

name.description: Optional: only records with this name (relative, e.g. 'holler.app' or '@')

type.description: Optional: only records of this type (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, …)

tools.name: get_container_metrics
tools.description: Get historical CPU/memory metrics for a container over a time period.

tools.name: update_nginx_config
tools.description: Update an Nginx site configuration. Validates with nginx -t before applying.

tools.name: renew_mtls_certificate
tools.description: Renew the mTLS certificate of a server's Docker proxy (ghostunnel). A new key is generated on the host, step-ca signs it, and the proxy restarts with it. If Whiskers cannot reach the host with the new certificate, the host restores the previous one by itself after 3 minutes. Admin only.

tools.name: connect_container_to_network
tools.description: Connect a container to a Docker network.

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete the DNS record(s) with the given name and type in a zone at the configured provider. Only A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT can be deleted. Answers what was removed; nothing there = no-op.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'holler.app' or '@'

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT

tools.name: stop_container
tools.description: Stop a running Docker container.

tools.name: cloud_shutdown
tools.description: Gracefully shut down a server (by Whiskers name or id) via its cloud provider.

tools.name: manage_systemd_service
tools.description: Manage a systemd service (start, stop, restart, enable, disable).

action.description: Action: start, stop, restart, enable, disable

tools.name: list_volumes
tools.description: List the Docker volumes on a server, so a backup gap can be spotted by comparing this against list_volume_backups. Read-only.

serverId.description: Server ID (optional, omit for the default server)

tools.name: assess_update_risk
tools.description: Assess what updating one container's image would change, BEFORE recreating anything. Compares what the running image and the candidate image declare — entrypoint, user, exposed ports, expected volumes, healthcheck, base OS — and counts which CVEs the update actually closes. Pulls the candidate image (starts and restarts nothing). Read-only with respect to running containers.

scanCandidate.description: Scan the candidate image for CVEs so the benefit has a number. Costs tens of seconds; without it the benefit is reported as unknown, never as zero.

tools.name: hetzner_disable_rescue
tools.description: Disable Hetzner rescue mode on a server (by Whiskers name or id).

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

tools.name: list_recent_alerts
tools.description: List the alerts and events Whiskers has raised recently (container down, restart loops, log-alert hits, CVE findings, agent actions), newest first. Optionally filter by severity or event type. Read-only — this cannot send notifications.

severity.description: Severity filter: info, warning, error, critical (optional)

eventType.description: Event type filter, e.g. container_down, log_alert (optional)

limit.description: How many to return, newest first (default 25, max 200)

tools.name: add_firewall_rule
tools.description: Add a firewall rule (UFW) to allow or deny traffic on a port.

tools.name: list_systemd_services
tools.description: List systemd services on a server.

tools.name: start_container
tools.description: Start a stopped Docker container.

tools.name: list_cloud_servers
tools.description: List all Whiskers servers that have a cloud provider (Hetzner/Hostinger) configured, with their live power status, type, location, IP, and (Hetzner) traffic usage.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search container logs for a pattern (text or regex). Searches every server unless a serverId is given. Returns matching lines across one or all containers.

containerId.description: Container name to search (optional, omit for all)

serverId.description: Server ID (optional, omit to search all servers)

tailLines.description: Number of log tail lines to search per container (default: 500)

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List all configured servers with their connection type and status. Optionally filter by a group or tag (case-insensitive) to narrow a large fleet.

tag.description: Optional group name or tag to filter by (case-insensitive). Omit to list all servers.

tools.name: cloud_metrics
tools.description: Get recent cloud metrics for a server (by Whiskers name or id). Hetzner type: cpu, disk, network. Hostinger returns raw metric data.

type.description: Metric type for Hetzner: cpu, disk, or network

tools.name: set_dns_record
tools.description: Create or update one DNS record at the configured provider — idempotent: an existing record with the same name and type is updated (never duplicated), and an identical value answers 'unchanged'. Types: A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), CNAME (hostname), TXT. Name is relative to the zone ('holler.app' → holler.app.<zone>, '@' = zone apex). Returns before/after.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'holler.app' or '@' for the zone itself

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT

value.description: Record value: IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, hostname for CNAME, text for TXT

tools.name: get_health_summary
tools.description: Get a health summary of all containers across all servers.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all databases in a database container.

tools.name: list_nginx_sites
tools.description: List Nginx sites (enabled and available) on a server.

tools.name: hetzner_disable_backups
tools.description: Disable Hetzner automated backups for a server (by Whiskers name or id). Existing backups are deleted.

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

tools.name: get_container_env
tools.description: Get environment variables of a running Docker container. Sensitive values (keys, secrets, passwords, tokens) are masked for security.

tools.name: list_firewall_rules
tools.description: List firewall (UFW) rules on a server.

tools.name: remove_network
tools.description: Remove a Docker network by name or ID.

tools.name: get_action_outcomes
tools.description: Report whether Whiskers' automatic actions actually worked: per action kind, how many were effective, how many changed nothing, and how many could not be measured at all. Read this before repeating an action — a kind with a poor hit rate is one where the cause probably lies elsewhere. A high 'not measurable' count means the checking itself has broken down, which is NOT the same as things being fine. Read-only.

days.description: How many days back to summarise (default 7, max 90)

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description: List all Docker containers across all configured servers. Returns container name, image, state, health, server, and compose project.

serverId.description: Optional server ID to filter by. Omit for all servers.

tools.name: delete_scheduled_task
tools.description: Delete a scheduled task by its task ID.

tools.name: get_auto_patch_status
tools.description: Report of the last security auto-patch cycle: which containers were rolled onto the newest image of their own tag, which were skipped and why (major version, floating tag without version, compose drift, excluded), and which were rolled back. Also shows whether auto-patching is on and when it runs.

tools.name: get_whiskers_self_status
tools.description: Report whether Whiskers itself is still working: for every background loop and server, how long ago it last completed a cycle, how long a cycle takes, how many failed, and which servers it deliberately skips and why — plus the per-server load budget and circuit-breaker state. Use this before trusting an absence of findings: a loop that has stopped produces no alerts at all, which looks exactly like a fleet with nothing wrong. Read-only.

tools.name: instruct_agent
tools.description: Instruct the Whiskers agent to carry out an operations task described in natural language. The agent plans and executes using Whiskers's tools, but runs with YOUR permissions and the configured guardrails — it can never exceed your rights or bypass the guardrails. Returns the agent's final answer plus a short log of the tools it ran.

prompt.description: The task for the agent, in natural language (e.g. 'restart the unhealthy containers on Badwolf').

tools.name: list_cve_groups
tools.description: List DE-DUPLICATED CVEs across the whole fleet: one entry per CVE-ID with every affected server/container behind it, how long it has been open, and whether a fix exists. Use this instead of the per-target tools to avoid duplicate CVEs.

minSeverity.description: Min severity to include: Low, Medium, High, Critical (default High)

fixableOnly.description: Only CVEs that have an available fix (default false)

tools.name: create_log_alert
tools.description: Create a log alert rule that triggers notifications when a pattern is found in container logs. Rules are evaluated on every configured server.

containerName.description: Container name (optional, omit for all containers). A name matches that container on EVERY server.

tools.name: set_container_env
tools.description: Set environment variables in a container's .env file and restart via docker compose. Only works for containers managed by docker-compose. Provide variables as 'KEY=VALUE' pairs separated by newlines or commas. Existing variables not included are kept unchanged.

envVars.description: Environment variables to set as 'KEY=VALUE' pairs, comma-separated (e.g. 'OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...,MODEL=gpt-4')

tools.name: get_blast_radius
tools.description: Who else a change to this container touches: which containers get recreated with it, which depend on it, which it depends on, and whether the operation would cut the connection Whiskers is using to perform it. Reads compose labels only — no pull, no probe. Useful before any restart, update or stop, not just updates.

changesProjectConfig.description: True when the change touches the compose project's configuration — a new or edited override file, a changed environment. Then EVERY service in the project is recreated, not just this one.

tools.name: resume_server_checks
tools.description: Resume Whiskers' background checks for a server that was paused. Safe to call even if it is not paused. Turning monitoring back on is never the dangerous direction, so this has no time limit.

serverId.description: Server ID whose background checks should resume

tools.name: restart_container
tools.description: Restart a Docker container.

tools.name: get_container_cves
tools.description: Get the CVE findings for a specific container image on a server.

minSeverity.description: Min severity to include: Low, Medium, High, Critical (default Low)

tools.name: get_cve_summary
tools.description: Get a CVE summary across all servers: per-server counts of CVE findings (OS + all containers) broken down by severity.

tools.name: pause_server_checks
tools.description: Pause Whiskers' own background checks (health, logs, metrics, CVE, image updates) for one server, for a bounded number of minutes. Use this when Whiskers itself is the load on a host. Interactive access keeps working, so the server can still be inspected. The pause is announced, expires by itself, and is reminded about if it outlives its reason. This does NOT stop the containers on that server and does NOT block anything running there.

serverId.description: Server ID whose background checks should pause

reason.description: Why — this is shown in the alert and in the reminder; be specific

minutes.description: Minutes to pause, 1 to 120 (default 30). Longer pauses are an operator decision, not an agent's.

tools.name: cloud_reboot
tools.description: Gracefully reboot a server (by Whiskers name or id) via its cloud provider.

tools.name: deploy_app
tools.description: Deploy a new application on a server using a standardized template. Supports common app types like web apps, databases, and custom Docker images. Creates the container with sensible defaults and starts it.

tools.name: hetzner_list_snapshots
tools.description: List Hetzner snapshots in the account of a given Whiskers server (by name or id).

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command on a server. Use with caution.

tools.name: get_container_logs
tools.description: Get logs from a Docker container.

tools.name: create_network
tools.description: Create a new Docker network.

driver.description: Network driver: bridge, overlay, macvlan (default: bridge)

tools.name: run_scheduled_task
tools.description: Run a scheduled task immediately (outside its normal schedule).

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a database with row counts and sizes.

tools.name: cloud_create_snapshot
tools.description: Create a snapshot of a server (by Whiskers name or id) via its cloud provider. Useful before risky changes. Note: Hostinger keeps only ONE snapshot per VM (replaces the previous).

tools.name: preview_auto_patch
tools.description: Start a DRY RUN of the security auto-patch cycle in the background: for every container with fixable vulnerabilities it pulls the newest image of the same tag, runs every guard (major version, compose drift) and puts the old tag back. Recreates nothing, whatever the settings say. Read the result with get_auto_patch_status after a few minutes.

tools.name: get_server_metrics
tools.description: Get historical CPU/memory metrics for a server over a time period.

tools.name: list_volume_backups
tools.description: List the Docker volume backups Whiskers has taken: volume, owning container, server, size and age. Answers 'when was this volume last backed up?'. Read-only — this cannot create or restore a backup.

serverId.description: Server ID to filter by (optional, omit for all servers)

tools.name: list_ssl_certificates
tools.description: List SSL/TLS certificates managed by certbot on a server.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Get the schema (columns, types, keys) of a table.

tools.name: disconnect_container_from_network
tools.description: Disconnect a container from a Docker network.

tools.name: deploy_compose
tools.description: Deploy an application using a docker-compose.yml content string. Creates and starts all services defined in the compose file.

tools.name: get_container_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Docker container including its configuration, ports, labels, and stats.

serverId.description: Server ID where the container runs

tools.name: remove_firewall_rule
tools.description: Remove a firewall rule by its number.

tools.name: get_log_hygiene_report
tools.description: Report the log-file situation on the fleet: which container logs are growing without a rotation limit (with size, growth per day, share of the free disk and the exact command to fix it), and which containers the log-alert scan steps over and why. Excluded containers are still covered by health, metric and CVE monitoring; only their log content is ignored. Read-only: this changes nothing and runs nothing — setting a rotation limit recreates the container, which is a person's decision.

serverId.description: Limit the report to one server (optional)

tools.name: cloud_power_on
tools.description: Power on a server (by Whiskers name or id) via its cloud provider.

tools.name: list_paused_servers
tools.description: List servers whose background checks are currently paused, with the reason, who paused them (an operator or Whiskers itself), and when the pause expires. A paused server produces no health, log, metric or CVE findings — silence from it means nothing is being looked at, not that nothing is wrong.

tools.name: renew_ssl_certificate
tools.description: Renew an SSL certificate using certbot.

certName.description: Certificate name (from list). Use 'all' to renew all.

tools.name: create_scheduled_task
tools.description: Create a new scheduled task (e.g., periodic backup, container restart, cleanup).

taskType.description: Task type: ContainerRestart, DbBackup, VolumeBackup, CustomCommand, Cleanup

targetId.description: Target ID (container name for restart/db-backup, volume name for volume-backup)

maxBackups.description: Max backups to retain (only for backup types, 0=unlimited)

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Get detailed system information for a server (OS, CPU, RAM, disk, Docker version, containers).

tools.name: get_nginx_config
tools.description: Get the Nginx configuration for a specific site.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List all Docker networks on a server. Shows name, driver, scope, subnet, and connected containers.

tools.name: get_update_status
tools.description: Check which containers have image updates available.

tools.name: hetzner_delete_snapshot
tools.description: Delete a Hetzner snapshot/image by its numeric ID, in the account of a given Whiskers server. Irreversible.

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server, selects the account)

tools.name: backup_database
tools.description: Create a database backup (dump) for a database container.

tools.name: list_scheduled_tasks
tools.description: List all scheduled tasks with their status, schedule, and last run info.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query or database command and return the results.

query.description: SQL query or database command to execute

tools.name: cloud_status
tools.description: Get the live cloud status of a Whiskers server (by name or id): provider, power state, type, location, IP, and (Hetzner) traffic usage and backups.

tools.name: hetzner_enable_rescue
tools.description: Enable Hetzner rescue mode on a server (by Whiskers name or id), then it must be reset to boot into rescue. Returns the temporary root password. Recovery when the OS won't boot.

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

tools.name: get_server_logs
tools.description: Get system logs from a server via journalctl. Can filter by service name.

priority.description: Priority filter: emerg, alert, crit, err, warning, notice, info, debug (optional)

tools.name: get_server_cves
tools.description: Get the CVE findings for the host OS on one server (pending security updates and the CVE IDs they address).

minSeverity.description: Min severity to include: Low, Medium, High, Critical (default Low)

tools.name: hetzner_enable_backups
tools.description: Enable Hetzner automated daily backups for a server (by Whiskers name or id). Adds ~20% to the server price.

server.description: Whiskers server name or id (must be a Hetzner server)

tools.name: list_log_alerts
tools.description: List all configured log alert rules.

tools.name: cloud_hard_reset
tools.description: HARD reset (power-cycle) a server via its cloud provider — forceful, use only when a graceful reboot is impossible (e.g. SSH unresponsive). Hetzner: true power-cycle; Hostinger: falls back to a restart (no hard reset available).

resources.name: my_permissions
resources.title: My permissions
resources.description: The calling key's (or signed-in user's) scope and the tools it may call — useful before planning a task.

resources.name: tool_catalog
resources.title: Tool catalog
resources.description: Every tool this Whiskers instance serves, with the permission level it requires and whether an admin has switched it off.

prompts.name: plan_safe_update
prompts.title: Plan a safe container update
prompts.description: Assess an image update for one container and produce a step-by-step plan with rollback, before any change.

arguments.name: container
arguments.description: Container id or name to update.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Optional server id or name the container runs on.

prompts.name: security_review_server
prompts.title: Security review of a server
prompts.description: Read-only security review of one server: CVEs, firewall, TLS certificates, exposed services.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Server id or name to review.

prompts.name: triage_unhealthy_containers
prompts.title: Triage unhealthy containers
prompts.description: Read-only diagnosis of unhealthy, stopped or restarting containers, with a ranked list of proposed fixes.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Optional server id or name to limit the triage to one server.

prompts.name: investigate_host_load
prompts.title: Investigate high host load
prompts.description: Find out why a server is busy, including load that no container accounts for.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Server id or name that looks overloaded.
